definitions.explanation: A formal and respectful term for the death of a person. Used in news reports and official announcements when reporting someone's death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{著名|ちょめい}→著名：13992_chomei⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{死去|しきょ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{享年|きょうねん}90⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{死去|しきょ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was announced that he died at the age of 90.

examples.japanese: ノーベル⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}→受賞者：24174_jushousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{博士|はかせ}→博士：03551_hakase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{死去|しきょ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Nobel laureate's family revealed that the doctor died at home due to illness.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, news-style term for death. Used in obituaries, news reports, and official announcements. More neutral and objective than ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧, which is an honorific term. Less formal than ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧ but more formal than ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧ (the most common everyday term for someone dying).

REGISTER COMPARISON:
- ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: standard, respectful (everyday)
- {死去|しきょ}: formal, objective (news/official)
- ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧: honorific, respectful (very formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{死去|しきょ}: died at age ~
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{死去|しきょ}: died due to illness
- {死去|しきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報|ほう}じられる→報じる：17193_houjiru⟧: death is reported
